dedupe_keys.name: pointer building point clouds and energy features

description: Technical University of Munich and Stanford University researchers publish PointER to connect building geometry with energy characteristics. The dataset contains more than one million LiDAR-derived building point clouds covering 16 English districts. About half are linked to energy-performance features through Unique Property Reference Numbers, which also allow further joins. The university landing page lists NumPy point-cloud arrays and JSON attributes, with two files totalling about 5.1 GB. Access is free under CC BY 4.0. The resource can help derive geometry and retrofit assumptions for building-stock simulations with model-energyplus. A caveat is that an available energy certificate is not a complete calibrated building model, and unmatched properties lack these features. Source surveys and certificates need not describe the same date. Only landing metadata and code documentation were inspected; no building or household records were downloaded.
